S01: Learn the key terms: Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), XR, and Mixed Reality (MR)
S02: Explore the main questions and significance of XR, AR, and VR technologies
S03: Understand XR as an umbrella term and define AR, VR, MR, and immersive technology
S04: Understand the reality-virtuality continuum and the difference between augmented reality and augmented virtuality
S05: Understand the field's growth potential using market statistics and the metaverse concept
S06: Learn the course structure, covering concepts, theory, and development using a digital heritage case study
S07: Recap XR concepts and preview the course using a digital heritage preservation example
